programs.title: Dodo Heroes
programs.desc: Inspiring stories about animals in need and the people who help them.Each episode highlights deep bonds between various representatives of the animal world and the people who save and care for them.In the program, viewers meet a former British Marine officer, Pen Farthing, who organized the adoption of over 700 stray dogs by soldiers serving in Afghanistan.They will also see an Australian family saving baby koalas.Animals need help after being hit by winter cyclones.Another extraordinary man in the program will be Derrick Campana, who creates prosthetics tailored specifically to the individual needs of animals, helping everyone from elephants to rabbits.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern begins another culinary adventure, during which he will again taste the strangest dishes in the world, from wild goat to duck liver.In the new season of the show, Andrew will taste snake eggs in Japan and drink snake bile in Shanghai.In Okinawa, people eat pickled pig's ear, poisonous urchin fish and tuna eye.Finally, he will go to China to try turtle, chicken hearts and snail shells.Viewers will find out whether Andrew will survive such a difficult test.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc:
Marcin Prokop will go on a spontaneous journey around America in a program full of humor.During his journey across the United States, which lasts over a month, the journalist will cover thousands of kilometers.Viewers will have the opportunity to see the alleys of the largest Chinese district in the US, find themselves behind the walls of the most famous prison, Alcatraz, and look out the window of the tallest skyscraper in San Francisco.The host will stop at the world's largest stop for giant trucks, visit a hippie town and visit a unique restaurant connected to a laundry.The audience will be able to feast their eyes on amazing landscapes, unique national parks and wonderful waterfalls
In the final episode, the creators of the program will visit Sioux Falls, the largest city in the state of South Dakota, whose most popular attraction are waterfalls.Marcin Prokop will assess whether it is worth going there.Then he will go to a creepy town, inspired by the Westworld series, inhabited by realistic-looking mannequins.The last point of Marcin Prokop's journey is Chicago.There he will visit the Polish district, see a fountain with many faces, and take a look at the largest bean in the world - Cloud Gate.In this episode, viewers will have the opportunity to follow the host's mishaps and find out what happened behind the scenes of the program.
